title: IANA says the DNS root zone is the top of the naming hierarchy and is principally delegations of top-level domains
summary: IANA says the DNS root zone is the top of the naming hierarchy and is principally delegations of top-level domains.
body: IANA says the DNS root zone is the highest level of the naming hierarchy, principally composed of delegations of top-level domains, and that IANA manages the root zone. The source says: "S) root zone is the highest-level of the naming hierarchy, principally composed of delegations of top-level domains (such as .edu or .in )." A top-level domain exists as a delegation in that zone. The page is IANA's description of its role. It does not say that IANA operates every name server that answers for those domains.
